name: Kuwait

chips.label: Granted prosperity
chips.why: Wealth has outrun institutions — historically fragile.
chips.rule: MI residual vs. the log-GDP regression (the durability gap): below −0.03 → granted, otherwise earned (a ±0.03 tolerance treats near-zero gaps as in-line).

chips.label: Lopsided · weakest: Economic Complexity
chips.why: Spread between the strongest and weakest pillar — the country's structural shape.

chips.label: Resource-dependent
chips.why: Resource rents ≈ 29% of GDP — prosperity leans on extraction.

verdict: Structurally durable — prosperity outrunning institutions — lopsided (economic complexity the weak point).

relational.label: Kuwait, pre-1990 (FRAGILE + SHIELDED by response) -> invaded then RESTORED by coalition
relational.joint_reading: HIGH structural exposure with NO standing deterrent — but a RESPONSE patron intervened to reverse the shock after it landed: survival came from outside help, not internal strength (e.g. Kuwait 1990, conquered then restored by the coalition).
relational.outcome_factual: Invaded by Iraq 2 Aug 1990; sovereignty restored by the coalition Feb 1991. SURVIVED via the response patron.
